description.plain: The Giza Percale Duvet by Sferra is a luxurious, year-round duvet cover crafted from 100% Giza 45 cotton. Renowned for its long staple fibers, the fabric provides a cool, crisp sleeping experience with exceptional smoothness and enduring strength. This duvet cover is designed with Italian craftsmanship and sophistication, available in classic White and Ivory colorways to complement various bedding styles.

description.plain: The Dune Bowl, part of the Dune Tableware Collection, is a sculptural porcelain piece designed by Kelly Wearstler. It serves as an elegant nod to ancient pottery, featuring a combination of matte and glossy finishes to create striking volumes. This versatile bowl can be used as a standalone accent or mixed and matched with other porcelain pieces from the collection to create a unique dinnerware set.

description.plain: Add a touch of Missoni's iconic style to your home with the Watamu Throw. This luxurious throw features a vibrant zigzag pattern in a multicolor palette, perfect for adding a pop of color and texture to any living space. Crafted from a blend of wool and polyamide, it offers both warmth and durability, making it an ideal accent piece for your sofa or bed. The fringed edges add a classic finishing touch.

description.plain: Discover the MB5 Outdoor Ottoman by Heller. Designed in 2005 by Mario Bellini, this modern icon couples technological innovation with bold, minimalist form. The MB5 Outdoor Ottoman is crafted in self-cushioning polymer and intended for indoor-outdoor use. Try it poolside with the MB2 Outdoor Sofa. Made in the USA. Available in white and dark gray. It features a sleek, minimalist design and is constructed from durable polyethylene using Worry Free Plastics technology, making it suitable for both indoor and outdoor environments.

description.plain: Experience ultimate comfort and absorbency with the Simple Terry Bath Mat from Hawkins New York. Made from 100% cotton and Oeko-Tex Standard 100 certified, this plush bath mat is machine washable for easy care. Its thick, terry texture provides a soft and cozy feel, making it a luxurious addition to any bathroom.

The Simple Terry Bath Mat by Hawkins New York is a practical and absorbent addition to any bathroom. Crafted from 100% cotton terry with a looped pile, it provides a soft underfoot experience and effective moisture trapping. Measuring 20" x 32", it is designed to fit seamlessly in front of tubs, showers, or sinks. The mat features finished edges to maintain its shape and comes in a variety of color options to coordinate with existing bathroom textiles.
